capabilities: Shows day, week, month, year and timeline calendar views
Displays lunar dates, solar terms, holidays and rest/work badges
Creates daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes from templates
Manages custom recurring items and tasks with a configurable form
Creates and edits tasks through the Tasks plugin panel
extras: Titled "Modular Calendar Beta"; no telemetry or payment. Holiday data is downloaded from network sources (TaiwanCalendar, holiday-cn, Nager.Date) and cached, with an offline "custom" JSON option. Uses undocumented Obsidian internals (Tasks and Templater APIs); developed and tested on desktop Windows, mobile untested.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar that combines lunar dates, solar terms, holidays, periodic notes, tasks and recurring items in configurable day cells.

relations.evidence: Optional Tasks plugin integration: right-click → "New task (Tasks style)" opens its "Create or edit task" panel
Templater syntax is processed if Templater is installed.

summary: Customizable Obsidian calendar with day, week, month and year views, lunar dates, solar terms, holidays, periodic notes, tasks and recurring items.
